references.text: The people were amazed at Jesus' teaching because he taught them as one who had authority, not like their scribes.
The people were amazed at Jesus' teaching because his words carried authority. He also commanded unclean spirits, and they obeyed him.
The officers sent to arrest Jesus returned and said that no one has ever spoken like this man.
Paul performed extraordinary miracles in Ephesus, so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched his skin were able to heal diseases and drive out evil spirits.
